name: Tam
identity: mature Frostline ice monk in ochre and saffron robes; cool grey-blue wraps on both forearms, palms and shins; one mala round the neck; no weapon, the wraps are his
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/tam.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Cold Breath
techniques.effect: The held breath steadies him: the next palm applies two frost instead of one.

upgrade.name: Cold Breath II
upgrade.effect: The steadied palm also slows the foe.

techniques.name: Ridge Wall
techniques.effect: The ridge ends in a low ice wall that stops projectiles for a moment.

upgrade.name: Ridge Wall II
upgrade.effect: A wall that is hit shatters and chills foes beside it.

techniques.name: Still Water Step
techniques.effect: A frost patch is left where he rolled; foes on it slow.

upgrade.name: Still Water Step II
upgrade.effect: Palms on a foe standing on the patch add one more frost.
